title: Germany – Construction work for bridges and tunnels, shafts and subways – Ersatzneubau EÜ Lenensruher Weg Str. 6441 km 96,664
description: Die DB InfraGO AG beabsichtigt den Ersatzneubau der Eisenbahnüberführung (EÜ) km 96,664 auf der Strecke 6441 (Dömitz – Wismar) im Bereich der Hansestadt Wismar. Im Zuge der Maßnahme wird das vorhandene Bauwerk vollständig zurückgebaut und durch einen Neubau in Form einer Stahltrogbrücke (Dickblechbrücke) mit neu hergestellten Stahlbeton-Kastenwiderlagern ersetzt. Die Strecke ist im Bereich der Maßnahme eingleisig und elektrifiziert. Die Eisenbahnüberführung überführt die öffentliche Straße „Lenensruher Weg“ / „Lenensruhe“, welche die einzige straßenseitige Erschließung des angrenzenden Wohngebietes darstellt. Während der Bauzeit ist daher eine durchgängige Aufrechterhaltung der Erreichbarkeit durch geeignete bauzeitliche Maßnahmen sicherzustellen. Die Bauausführung erfolgt unter Berücksichtigung betrieblicher Einschränkungen des Eisenbahnbetriebs und unter Einhaltung vorgegebener Sperrpausen.

title: COPERNICUS SPACE COMPONENTS - COMPETITIVE FRAME CONTRACTS - LONG TERM ARCHIVE SERVICE FOR COPERNICUS
description: This procurement targets the delivery of the Copernicus Space Component Long Term Archive service.The Long Term Archive service aims at the ingestion, archive, preservation and retrieval of Copernicus Sentinel products.In order to maximise the competition andvalue for money for the service to be procured, the Long Term Archive Service will be implemented through the ESA Framework Agreements procedure, as established at Article 15 of ESA Procurement Regulations (ESA/REG/001, rev. 3) which can be downloaded at the following URLhttp://emits.sso.esa.int/emits/owa/emits.main). This procedure consists of a two-step procurement approach, broken down as follows:Step 1 - Open Qualification Period: The objective of this Step is to award, through an Open Competition (Frame ITT), Frame Contracts to several Frame-Contractors (Competitive Frame Contracts)Step 2 - Long Term Archive Service Implementation: The objective of this Step is to award the Work Orders through Restricted Competitions (RFP) between the Frame Contractors qualified under Step 1, allowing the implementation of the requested Long Term Archive Service.An Information day for this procurement will be held at ESRIN at 10:00am CEST on July 12th 2019. Further information on this briefing session has been published on ESA Tendering website (EMITS) under NEWS (http://emits.sso.esa.int/emits/owa/emits.main). Potential bidders are invited to consult regularly the ESA Tendering website. This Long Term Archive Service is funded by the Copernicus Programme and will be open exclusively to economic operators, that have their registered office in an EU Member State or Iceland or Norway. In order to access the Frame ITT Package from EMITS, any economic operator interested in the procurement will have to be registered as a potential ESA Tenderer. To register with ESA as a potential Tenderer, it is necessary to complete the online questionnaire available on the ESA-STAR registration website: https://esastar-emr.sso.esa.int. Whilst the registration process is underway, potential ESA Tenderers may access the Frame ITT Package through ESA's dedicated Copernicus server: https://copernicus-emits.esa.int/

title: Oszilloskop mit 20 GHz Bandbreite
description: Als Basisgerät zur Jittermessung soll das Oszilloskop Signale mit einer Frequenz von bis zu 20 GHz abtasten und bezüglich ihrer Jitteranteile untersuchen können. Um Radar-Signale möglichst genau erfassen zu können, soll das Oszilloskop eine native vertikale Auflösung von 12 Bit besitzen. Um eine sehr hohe Eindeutigkeit bzgl. des Abtasttheorems zu erhalten, sollen die Signale mit mindestens 120 Giga-Samples pro Sekunde abgetastet werden. Zur Erhöhung des Integrationsgewinns sind Radarsignale oft bis zu zehn Millisekunden lang. Um diese Signale vollständig mit dem Oszilloskop abtasten zu können, wird ein Speicher von mindestens 2 Giga-Punkten benötigt. Neben der Analyse im Zeitbereich sollte das Oszilloskop auch die Umrechnung in den Frequenzbereich für die volle analoge Bandbreite von 20 GHz ermöglichen, damit Störsignale und die spektrale Reinheit an einem Gerät untersucht werden können. Zur direkten Analyse der Radarsignale auf dem Oszilloskop sollte zusätzlich die Ausführbarkeit von MATLAB-Code möglich sein.

description: Het Netherlands Space Office koopt sinds 2012 namens de Nederlandse overheid satellietdata in en stelt deze data gratis beschikbaar aan Nederlandse entiteiten via het Satellietdataportaal (http://www.satellietdataportaal.nl, ftp.satellietdataportaal.nl en api.satellietdataportaal.nl). title: Provision of a Platform Supply Vessel (PSV)
description: TenneT is requires a reliable, trustworthy and highly professional provider of Platform Supply Vessels (PSV) and crew to conclude a multiple year charter contract for the initial duration: 15.04.2025-28.02.2030 plus 3 options of 1 year extensions each. (almost 8 years in total). Purpose of the PSV, as integral part of TenneT's logistics chain, is to conduct supply tours to TenneT's offshore platforms in the German North Sea. It is to ensure the provision of the Client's platforms with maintenance material, food/provisions, and consumables as well as for disposal services. The main load of the vessel will be certified offshore containers, break bulk cargo and various liquids. The minimum requirements for the required PSV are as follows: - Vessel type: Platform Supply Vessel (PSV) - Dynamic Positioning (DP): Class 2 - Flag: Paris MoU White-listed - Class Society: IACS Member - Automatic Identification System (AIS) and radar - Deck space: min. 1.000 m² (free from obstructions, vertically reachable and useable for cargo handling and stowage). - Year of construction: not older than year 2007 (if the keel laying date was more than 24 months before the date of delivery of the Vessel, then the keel laying date shall be applicable for evaluation of the vessel age) - Draught: max. 8 m - Minimum no. of reefer connections (440 volts) for constant cooling of reefer containers: 12 - Tank capacities (for client’s usage only): DRINKING WATER: min. 300 m³, divided into at least two tanks with a min. capacity of 60 m³. Pump rate of 0-200 cbm/h is required. WASTE WATER: min. 300 m³. BILGE WATER: min. 300 m³. MARINE GAS OIL (MGO): min. 400 m³ divided into two tanks of min. 200 m³ each (to be proven by tank arrangement plan indicating the tanks for vessel’s own usage and clients usage). Pump rate of 0-200 cbm/h is required. The application for the call for competition must be submitted in due time and no later than by 13.09.2024 at 12:00 CET via the e-Award platform Mercell Source-to-Contract. Individual extensions of time will not be granted. Submission of the request to participate (applications) by Email, mail or fax are not permitted. A violation of this requirement will lead to disqualification of the applicant and exclusion from the tender process. In order to protect the confidentiality of the information provided by the client in the tender documents, it is mandatory to conclude a confidentiality Agreement as per "NDA" document provided for download via Mercell. Please send the signed and stamped copy to: dominik.schellhase@tennet.eu. After sending the NDA and a plausibility check by the Client, the Client will grant the interested parties access to the tender by Email. After registering for the tender at Mercell Source-to-Contract, you will find all tender documents for the call for competition phase as well as the offer phase under "Questionnaires", section "Call for Competition", question 1.2.1. The bidder can not deduce eligibility for participation only from signing and submitting the NDA. TenneT will only accept tenderers who successfully qualify during the call for competition phase to participate in the offer phase.
